summary: Validates an unsigned index against 102 (0x66) and returns a pointer to the element at byte offset 436 * index inside the array rooted at this, or NULL when the index is out of range. Called by many scoring, commentary, session-search and config-lookup helpers to index a fixed element table.

operations.description: Guard on index > 102 (0x66): reject out-of-range index by returning a null pointer.
Compute the element byte offset as 436 * index.
Return pointer to this + element byte offset (element array indexer).

unresolved: Element type and meaning of the 436-byte stride are caller-dependent and not evidenced here.
